approved_decisions.3D-2: Use High 80-100, Medium 60-79 and Low 0-59 confidence bands.

approved_decisions.3D-8: Treat Apify email search as independent provider evidence, require identity/company match and never infer consent.

approved_decisions.3D-10: Allow verified material evidence to trigger an A1 requalification signal without A2 calculating a score.
